runtime_rule: Actual merge/deployment identity must be appended to checkpoint. Close prior main identity on restart; retain mixed/late-join slots. Do not pool old and corrected feature timing.
eligibility: Every scheduled 900-second slot retained, official and calendar coverage denominators separate; no late-join excluded from calendar. If deployment misses start, mark intervals unavailable; do not slide windows.
promotion_rule: Corrected timestamps require new live feature parity and gap/price/qualification evidence. Historical threshold probes rejected; no tuning on validation. No claim of production performance acceptance.
